summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (delegates to print with emoji/markup off, no_wrap on, overflow ignore, crop off; highlight defaults to True). Added tests in tests/test_console.py (test_out plus markup, emoji, container, no_crop, style, highlight default/false/none, render_hook), a CHANGELOG "Added Console.out" entry, and a "Low level output" section in docs/source/console.rst. Nothing was committed and no tests were run, per instructions, so the new tests are unverified. Some new test lines exceed black's line length and were not reformatted.
